questions.question: Identify the correct sentence with formal register and complex sentence structure: We require that all applications be submitted online by the closing date, which is detailed in the prospectus.
options: We require that all applications be submitted online by the closing date, which is detailed in the prospectus.
We require that all applications are submitted online by the closing date, which is detailed in the prospectus.
We require that all applications submit online by the closing date, which is detailed in the prospectus.
We require that all applications were submitted online by the closing date, which is detailed in the prospectus.
questions.answer: We require that all applications be submitted online by the closing date, which is detailed in the prospectus.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses ellipsis to maintain parallelism and conciseness? After careful consideration, the committee decided to proceed with the project rather than abandon it.
options: After careful consideration, the committee decided to proceed with the project rather than abandon it.
After careful consideration, the committee decided to proceed with the project rather than they abandon it.
After careful consideration, the committee decided to proceed with the project rather than that they abandon it.
After careful consideration, the committee decided to proceed with the project rather than to abandon it.
questions.answer: After careful consideration, the committee decided to proceed with the project rather than abandon it.

questions.question: Select the grammatically correct and most appropriate sentence for a formal report: It is recommended that the budget be reviewed quarterly to ensure fiscal responsibility.
options: It is recommended that the budget be reviewed quarterly to ensure fiscal responsibility.
It is recommended that the budget reviews quarterly to ensure fiscal responsibility.
It is recommended that the budget be reviewing quarterly to ensure fiscal responsibility.
It is recommended that the budget is reviewed quarterly to ensure fiscal responsibility.
questions.answer: It is recommended that the budget be reviewed quarterly to ensure fiscal responsibility.

questions.question: Which option correctly demonstrates the use of a cleft sentence to emphasize the location? London, rather than any other major city, was the venue for the conference.
options: London, rather than any other major city, was the venue for the conference.
Rather than any other major city, London was the venue for the conference.
The venue for the conference was London, rather than any other major city.
Any other major city was not the venue for the conference; it was London.
questions.answer: London, rather than any other major city, was the venue for the conference.

questions.question: Identify the correct sentence with formal inversion due to the restriction of adverbial position: Only after the extensive research was the hypothesis fully validated.
options: Only after the extensive research was the hypothesis fully validated.
Only after the extensive research did the hypothesis fully validate.
Only after the extensive research was the hypothesis validating fully.
Only after the extensive research has the hypothesis fully validated.
questions.answer: Only after the extensive research was the hypothesis fully validated.
